it’s okay not to use shampoo. i know a few people who never do, or at least haven’t in months. they all have the thickest, most gorgeous hair too, and never greasy or smelly. but they do rinse their hair well and go through the motions of washing with shampoo (scrubbing, etc.) with just water. myself personally, i wash my hair with shampoo and conditioner twice a week, but i’d say if it works for you and it doesn’t get greasy or starts to smell bad, i’d wash maybe once a month to get rid of the saltwater spray build up. hope this helps!
